goal: Produce matched group-heldout predictions for every original Hep train row with fixed current MiniMol+TabICL, local-label readout and original MLP control; identify complete rescue/harm/common-error cohorts and choose the next intervention from evidence.

why_now.limits: Old high-tail gains do not establish a replacement for current TabICL. No full OOF for these three recipes exists. New folds improve train-internal coverage, not independence from historical research selection.

fixed_group_keys.source: input/old-partitions/{scheme}.json row_assignments, element0=original row index, element1=exact existing group key
fixed_group_keys.canonical: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES, no salt/tautomer cleanup
fixed_group_keys.scaffold: Existing Murcko includeChirality=False; empty -> ACYCLIC::canonical, parse failure -> RAW::original. Do not regenerate keys or silently alter chemistry.
fixed_group_keys.validation: Both source records must bind the exact 848-row CSV and ordered Drug_ID/Drug; whole groups never cross fit/stop/outer-test in a scheme.

outer_partition.algorithm: For each scheme, collect row IDs by existing group key. Sort keys by (-group_size, SHA256(UTF8("HOOF001|outer|20261103|"+scheme+"|"+key)), key). Assign each entire group in that order to fold with smallest current row count, ties smallest fold index 0..4. No reshuffling/label balancing/retry for nicer outcomes. Each row is outer test exactly once per scheme.

inner_partition.algorithm: For outer fold f, exclude its test groups. Order remaining group keys by (SHA256(UTF8("HOOF001|inner|20261103|"+scheme+"|"+str(f)+"|"+key)),key). Walk whole groups into stop until row count >= Python round(0.125*n_outer_train_rows), remaining groups fit. Ascending original row order within each membership. No labels used.
inner_partition.common_context: ALL three methods use exactly inner-fit rows for gradient training/bank/TabICL context and any fitted preprocessing. Inner stop only selects MLP/local epochs; TabICL leaves it unused. No outer-train refit/addition of stop rows this cycle. Thus roughly70/10/20 original rows for all recipes.

representation.raw_cache: Original approved 848x512 raw train cache on training host; binding supplied to Sol separately. No new encoding.
representation.feature_scaler: Same H0 per-fold fit-only float32 mean/std ddof0; d=1 if std<1e-8 else std; all query/stop transformed using that fit state. Never reuse old fitted scaler.
representation.target_scaler: MLP/local use accepted fit-only target scaler with original train.Y and inverse exactly once; TabICL preserves original-Y context and its native context-only preprocessing.

recipes.mlp: Copy original MLP configs:512->256 ReLU dropout0.1->1, AdamW lr0.0005 wd0.0001,batch128,max50,patience8,min_delta1e-7,earliest best, original MSE zY. Only run/partition/source-link fields change.
recipes.local: Copy original regression B recipe: Linear512->128 bias, Euclidean p2 unsquared, full softmax T1, no embedding normalization/PLR/blocks/dropout/topk; train candidates floor(.5*(fit-minus-batch)), append batch once, own-row self mask only; inference all fit; AdamW .01/.0002,50epochs/pat8/b128. Preserve exact source science; only new partition envelope needed.
recipes.tabicl: Copy approved Mini H0 TabICLRegressor config, n_estimators8,batch_size8,feat_shuffle_method latin,norm_methods null,outlier4,kv_cachefalse,AMPfalse,FA3false,auto_downloadfalse,random_state44/45. All pretrained parameters/buffers frozen. No TabICL finetuning.

scientific_changes_allowed: Only new OOF group partition construction/validation, partition-aware config binding and output routing. Preserve model, losses, learning rates, batch/RNG, metrics and preprocessing arithmetic. No false old threeway_hash method labels or monkeypatching a wrong method name to bypass validation. Use an explicit narrow new OOF method and validated adapter/private derivative with lineage.
locking: Freeze all10 partition records and60 configs before any learning. For each scheme, all20 gradient best states and10 context states/predictions must be locked before first outer-label metric review. Stage canonical then scaffold allowed, but later configs remain pre-frozen and no tuning from canonical results. Inner stop labels allowed for predefined early stopping only.
outputs: Per scheme each method/seed yields exactly848 OOF predictions, original rowID/Drug_ID/Drug/fold/group key/source identity, no dropped/merged rows. Each prediction tied to fit/stop/test membership and saved selected model/context. Store per-fold originals, initial/best/physical-last/optimizer/used RNG as applicable, fold fit scaler/bank and provenance. Report formal fold Spearman/MAE after locking, equal-seed prediction metrics distinct from mean of seed scores; pooled Spearman descriptive only.

analysis_contract.primary: Mini local vs current Mini TabICL, paired within identical folds; MLP matched control explains earlier gains. Per-fold equal-seed predictions:5 Spearman differences per scheme and unweighted mean, seed-specific signs separately. Pooled OOF rank is descriptive, not independent generalization estimate.
fixed_cohorts: previously covered306 and uncovered542 from old union
original CB fixed cohorts when membership available
all other rows for each fixed cohort
analysis_contract.complete_error_sets: Within each scheme, average predictions over44/45 per method. Define per-row absolute error, local-minus-Tab absolute-error delta; record every row with delta<0,>0,=0 and 5 raw-Y-unit material improvement/harm as descriptive threshold, not assay uncertainty. Define large error abs_error>=50 and agreement abs(local-Tab)<=10; complete shared-large-error, low-disagreement-shared-error, Tab-only-large/local-only-large cohorts. Record all memberships, counts and complement controls. These are diagnostic flags, not clinical accuracy/label correctness.
analysis_contract.uncertainty: Paired whole-group bootstrap2000 seed20261103, within each outer fold for fold-average Spearman difference, preserve same group draw across methods/seeds. Tail MAE whole-group bootstrap. Descriptive conditional uncertainty, no independence or multiple-testing correction claim. Do not call non-significant null evidence of equality.
analysis_contract.chemistry: Reuse actual canonical/scaffold keys; quantify group sizes, duplicates with different givenY, fit-neighbor support/similarity only if original compatible fingerprints already bound or new deterministic descriptor analysis separately registered. No label editing, pseudo labels or claim that disagreement proves mislabeling.
analysis_contract.next_decision: If local reliably improves a coherent cohort without broad rank harm, examine a fixed blending/support mechanism next under a separate task. If benefits fail on newly covered rows or shared errors dominate, close replacement claim and target representation/support/assay-condition explanation. No automatic blend grid/OOF stacker/Valid query under this task.
